name: todo-webapp

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Loads, creates, edits, completes and deletes todos.

description: The single-page app where the User sees the todo list and adds, completes, renames and deletes todos, with an empty-list message and blank-title validation. A separate deployable because it is the only browser surface. It has no sign-in and holds no data itself; everything goes through todo-api.
